C-KEITARO-TOOL-BOOTSTRAP-20261118.Summary: Bootstrap the Keitaro campaign tool: FastAPI + SQLAlchemy backend, React FSD frontend, docker compose, GRACE governance.
C-KEITARO-TOOL-BOOTSTRAP-20261118.Problem: The Adrobot test assignment needs a campaign creator (name + geo + offer -> campaign with domain, group, source and two streams) and an offer editor for existing campaigns (add/remove offers with correct shares and stats), delivered as a repository with migrations and run instructions.

Goals.Goal: POST /api/campaigns creates a Keitaro campaign with stream 1 (forced, country accept filter, redirect to Google) and stream 2 (regular, landings schema, chosen offer at 100%), with domain, group and traffic source set.
Editor endpoints list streams with offers, shares and per-offer stats; add/remove rebalance active shares equally; manual shares must sum to 100.
PostgreSQL stores created campaigns and an offer change log, managed by Alembic.
React + Vite + TanStack Query + Tailwind + shadcn/ui frontend on Feature-Sliced Design using types generated from contracts/openapi.json.
CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md rules: no tests, API contract changes only through GRACE bundles, small UI changes may be direct fixes.

Constraints.Constraint: Tests are banned; evidence is make gate-backend, gate-frontend, gate-openapi, gate-compose and grace lint.
Keitaro API key stays in apps/backend/.env (gitignored).

NonGoals.NonGoal: No authentication of tool users, no landing management, no editing of non-offer stream settings.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: A campaign created through the UI appears in Keitaro with the two streams described above and its URL is shown.
In the editor, adding offers gives 100 -> 50/50 -> 34/33/33, removing rebalances, manual shares not summing to 100 are rejected, and every change is logged.
All make gate-* targets and grace lint exit 0.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: Fresh gate output, grace lint with 0 errors, live creator/editor run against the configured Keitaro tracker.

Assumptions.Assumption: The reference editor video was not available to the implementer; the equal-rebalance share rule is recorded in requirements.xml Decisions and can be changed through a new change bundle.
User approval: the user requested this bootstrap in chat on 2026-11-18 and asked to start immediately.
